name: Tales in Distress 2
source:
An adventure sequel set in a fantasy world ruled by sword and magic.
Shortly after the bandits are vanquished from the village, their evil influence
returns to disrupt the heroic sisters' lives. Queruca is tortured and
enslaved in the underground bandit lair.

Rinna and Helvetica infiltrate the lair, but all three girls are overpowered.
They each are sexually violated! Can they escape?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075858.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
设定在剑与魔法的奇幻世界的冒险续作。
山贼被赶出村庄后不久，他们的邪恶势力
卷土重来，扰乱了英勇姐妹们的生活。奎尔卡在地下的
山贼巢穴中遭受折磨并被奴役。

琳娜和赫尔维提卡潜入巢穴，但三个女孩都被制服了。
她们各自遭受了性侵犯！她们能逃脱吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075858.html]DLSite English[/url]]
